$comment: Copy to pages.json next to psi-run.mjs (or point at it with --pages / $PSI_PAGES) and replace EVERY value below with your own. This is the inventory the report is built from: `sections` become the section bands in the Sheet (in this order), `pages` become the page blocks under them (in this order), and `id` is the permanent key the Sheet carries rounds over by — rename an id and you orphan its history. `path` is joined to `baseUrl`, so pointing baseUrl at staging vs production is what makes a round a staging round or a production round; the env you pass to psi-run.mjs (--env) must match the host you are actually measuring, because a staging number and a production number are not comparable. runsPerPage 3 is the floor, not a suggestion: one Lighthouse load is noise, the cell carries the median of the runs, and fewer successful runs than this target is recorded as 'not-run' — never as a partial green number.
